sample_distribution: sample unbiased structures from a SynJax Distribution using a PRNG key and optional temperature
differentiable_sample_distribution: differentiable sample structures from a Distribution using Perturb-and-Marginals or Perturb-and-SoftmaxDP methods
compute_log_partition: compute the log-partition function for a Distribution to normalize log probabilities
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two compatible SynJax Distributions
find_top_k_structures: find the top-k highest scoring structures and their unnormalized scores from a SemiringDistribution
